name: TimeLine
description: Stores animation information for a Master, Slide, or SlideRange object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.description: Returns a Sequence object that represents the collection of Effect objects in the main animation sequence of a slide.

properties.name: InteractiveSequences
